title: Persepolis (bc30)
synopsis: In 1970s Iran, Marjane ‘Marji’ Satrapi watches events through her young eyes and her idealistic family of a long dream being fulfilled of the hated Shah’s defeat in the Iranian Revolution of 1979. However as Marji grows up, she witnesses first hand how the new Iran, now ruled by Islamic fundamentalists, has become a repressive tyranny on its own.

synopsis_lang.en: In 1970s Iran, Marjane ‘Marji’ Satrapi watches events through her young eyes and her idealistic family of a long dream being fulfilled of the hated Shah’s defeat in the Iranian Revolution of 1979. However as Marji grows up, she witnesses first hand how the new Iran, now ruled by Islamic fundamentalists, has become a repressive tyranny on its own.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 《我在伊朗長大》的創作人莎塔碧在革命爆發時，仍只是個八歲的小女孩。和其他同齡女孩一樣，她熱愛幻想，具備冒險精神，向往自由自在的生活。德黑蘭的生活，本是無憂的；革命來了，世界不再一樣。年紀輕輕的女孩提早接觸到成年世界的殘酷，以及現實社會的巨大變動。《我在伊朗長大》 是她童年回憶，先以漫畫小說形式表達，再與雲信柏羅洛合作把之變成動畫。畫面是簡單的黑與白，但故事中的愛恨悲喜卻絕未因此而有半點褪色。

director_lang.zh_hk: 瑪嘉莎塔碧、雲信柏羅洛

cast: Chiara Mastroianni, Catherine Deneuve, Danielle Darrieux
